title: Chicken and Cheese Quesadillas
blurb: Crisp tortillas filled with tender chicken, melted cheese and fresh herbs.
steps: Shred or chop the cooked chicken into small pieces and grate the cheese.
Trim and finely slice the spring onions, then roughly chop the coriander.
Lay four tortillas on a work surface and divide the chicken, cheese, spring onions and coriander among them, keeping the filling to one half of each tortilla.
Fold each tortilla in half to enclose the filling and press down gently.
Heat half the butter in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook two quesadillas for about two minutes on each side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Repeat with the remaining butter and quesadillas, then cut each one into wedges and serve.
